ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7); no driver account flag — cancellation rate handling remains with Ryde's CR mechanism.
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: the chat (F7–F9) and the driver's post-trip statement (F10) contain no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation; dispute type is no_show, not safety. safety_concern = none.

Routing: cancellation was by the rider (F2), so under NS-0 the case runs on NS-4 (on-demand, rider cancels). System records: accepted 14:05:00, cancelled 14:07:55 = 2 min 55 s after matching, i.e. ≤ 3:00 [F2]. NS-4 first branch applies: cancellations within 3 minutes of matching are not chargeable → the $6.61 fee [F5] did not arise. The rider's own account ("less than 3 minutes") matches the timeline record [F2].

The driver-side no-show route (NS-1/NS-2) is not the operative route because the driver did not cancel, but it is consistent: no "I'm Here" tap and no platform auto-arrival [F4], and the driver never came within 200 m of the pickup (closest 2189 m) [F1], so no waiting-time or no-show fee could attach either. Driver's statement "I was on my way when the rider cancelled" [F10] is a statement, not consent or a defence, and does not change the rider's free-cancellation window; the NS-2 flag (GPS outside pickup at tap) is not triggered because there was no tap. Traffic facts [F11][F12] are irrelevant to NS-4; slow traffic does not extend the chargeable window (Ryde has no ETA-based waiver rule, NS-8 is informational only).

Amount: full refund of the disputed item = $6.61 [F5]. Under NS-7 the refund is issued as a Ryde voucher, non-exchangeable for cash, and the dispute appears timely (trip same-day). No erroneous driver action is established (driver never tapped "I'm Here" nor claimed a no-show), so no flag_account.

Calculation: $6.61 × 1 = $6.61 (ride not cancelled by driver; no partial reduction applies since the whole charge is improper).

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's statement that he was en route is a statement only; under NS-4 the rider's fee window depends on the matching-to-cancellation time in the timeline record (2 min 55 s, F2), not on the driver's position, and the record shows the driver was 2189 m away with no arrival confirmation (F1, F3, F4).
Not applicable: the trip was cancelled by the rider, not by the driver on a no-show claim, so the NS-1/NS-2 driver-cancellation route does not arise.
Slow traffic (speed band 4) does not extend the rider's free-cancellation period; NS-8 (ETA-delay waiver) is informational only and Ryde has no such rule.
